017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import java.io.*;
020import java.nio.charset.*;
021import java.time.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.logging.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.client.assertion.*;
026
027/**
028 * An HTTP response returned by {@link RestRequest#run()}.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * Wraps the transport-layer {@link TransportResponse} and provides higher-level accessors.
032 * Callers <b>must</b> close this response (it implements {@link Closeable}) to release transport resources.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
036 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
037 * (and possibly earlier).
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings({
042   "resource" // response is owned and closed via RestResponse.close(); getBodyStream() transfers ownership to caller
043})
044public final class RestResponse implements Closeable {
045
046   private final TransportResponse response;
047   private final RestClient client;
048   private final RestRequest request;
049   private final Level debugLevel;
050   private final InputStream body;
051   private byte[] cachedContent;
052   private long cachedContentLength = -1;
053   private boolean debugEmitted;
054   private Duration execTime;
055   // The X-Request-Id echoed by the server for this exchange, captured at onConnect; null when the server echoed
056   // none (or onConnect never ran on a synthetic error).  Never silently falls back to the sent id.
057   private String requestId;
058
059   RestResponse(TransportResponse response, RestClient client) {
060      this(response, client, null, null, 0);
061   }
062
063   RestResponse(TransportResponse response, RestClient client, RestRequest request, Level debugLevel, int debugBodyCap) {
064      this.response = response;
065      this.client = client;
066      this.request = request;
067      this.debugLevel = debugLevel;
068      var originalBody = response.getBody();
069      if (debugLevel == Level.FINEST && originalBody != null)
070         this.body = new BoundedCaptureInputStream(originalBody, debugBodyCap);
071      else
072         this.body = originalBody;
073      if (originalBody == null) {
074         cachedContentLength = 0;
075      } else {
076         var h = response.getFirstHeader("Content-Length");
077         if (h != null) {
078            try {
079               cachedContentLength = Long.parseLong(h.value());
080            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
081               cachedContentLength = -1;
082            }
083         }
084      }
085   }
086
087   /**
088    * Returns the client that produced this response.
089    *
090    * <p>
091    * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
092    * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
093    * (and possibly earlier).
094    *
095    * @return The client that produced this response. Never <jk>null</jk>.
096    */
097   public RestClient getClient() {
098      return client;
099   }
100
101   /**
102    * Returns the HTTP status code.
103    *
104    * @return The status code (e.g. {@code 200}).
105    */
106   public int getStatusCode() {
107      return response.getStatusCode();
108   }
109
110   /**
111    * Returns the reason phrase (e.g. {@code "OK"}), or {@code null} if absent.
112    *
113    * @return The reason phrase, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
114    */
115   public String getReasonPhrase() {
116      return response.getReasonPhrase();
117   }
118
119   /**
120    * Returns the {@code X-Request-Id} correlation id the server echoed for this exchange.
121    *
122    * <p>
123    * Captured at {@code onConnect} from the response header (which may differ from the sent id if the server
124    * sanitized it).  Returns <jk>null</jk> when the server echoed no id, or on a synthetic no-response error where
125    * {@code onConnect} never ran &mdash; it never silently falls back to the sent id.
126    *
127    * @return The echoed correlation id, or <jk>null</jk> if none was observed.
128    * @since 10.0.0
129    */
130   public String getRequestId() {
131      return requestId;
132   }
133
134   /**
135    * Records the correlation id echoed by the server for this exchange (auto-send interceptor internal use).
136    *
137    * @param value The echoed id.
138    */
139   void setEchoedRequestId(String value) {
140      this.requestId = value;
141   }
142
143   /**
144    * Returns all response headers.
145    *
146    * @return An unmodifiable list. Never <jk>null</jk>.
147    */
148   public List<TransportHeader> getHeaders() {
149      return response.getHeaders();
150   }
151
152   /**
153    * Returns the first response header with the given name (case-insensitive), or {@code null} if absent.
154    *
155    * @param name The header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
156    * @return The first matching header, or <jk>null</jk> if absent.
157    */
158   public TransportHeader getFirstHeader(String name) {
159      return response.getFirstHeader(name);
160   }
161
162   /**
163    * Returns the response body as a UTF-8 string, or {@code null} if there is no body.
164    *
165    * @return The body as a string, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
166    * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs reading the body.
167    */
168   public String getBodyAsString() throws IOException {
169      var stream = this.body;
170      if (stream == null)
171         return null;
172      return new String(stream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
173   }
174
175   /**
176    * Returns the raw response body stream, or {@code null} if there is no body.
177    *
178    * <p>
179    * Callers must not close this stream directly — close the {@link RestResponse} instead.
180    *
181    * @return The body stream, possibly <jk>null</jk>.
182    */
183   public InputStream getBodyStream() {
184      return body;
185   }
186
187   /**
188    * Asserts that the status code is in the 2xx range.
189    *
190    * @return This object (for chaining).
191    * @throws RestCallException If the status code is not 2xx.
192    */
193   public RestResponse assertOk() throws RestCallException {
194      var sc = response.getStatusCode();
195      if (sc < 200 || sc > 299)
196         throw new RestCallException(sc, "Expected 2xx status but got " + sc + " " + response.getReasonPhrase());
197      return this;
198   }
199
200   /**
201    * Asserts that the status code equals the expected value.
202    *
203    * @param expected The expected status code.
204    * @return This object (for chaining).
205    * @throws RestCallException If the status code does not match.
206    */
207   public RestResponse assertStatus(int expected) throws RestCallException {
208      var actual = response.getStatusCode();
209      if (actual != expected)
210         throw new RestCallException(actual, "Expected status " + expected + " but got " + actual);
211      return this;
212   }
213
214   /**
215    * Returns a fluent body accessor for this response.
216    *
217    * @return A new body accessor. Never <jk>null</jk>.
218    */
219   public ResponseBody body() {
220      return new ResponseBody(this);
221   }
222
223   /**
224    * Returns a fluent assertion object for this response.
225    *
226    * <p>
227    * Use this for test-style validation of the response in production or test code:
228    * <p class='bjava'>
229    *    <jv>resp</jv>.assertThat()
230    *       .statusCode(200)
231    *       .body().contains(<js>"alice"</js>);
232    * </p>
233    *
234    * @return A new assertion object. Never <jk>null</jk>.
235    */
236   public ResponseAssertion assertThat() {
237      return new ResponseAssertion(this);
238   }
239
240   /**
241    * Returns a fluent header accessor for the named response header.
242    *
243    * @param name The header name (case-insensitive). Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
244    * @return A new header accessor. Never <jk>null</jk>.
245    */
246   public ResponseHeader header(String name) {
247      return new ResponseHeader(name, this);
248   }
249
250   @Override /* Closeable */
251   public void close() throws IOException {
252      if (body instanceof BoundedCaptureInputStream bcis) {
253         bcis.drain();
254         cachedContent = bcis.getCapturedBytes();
255         cachedContentLength = bcis.getTotalBytesRead();
256      }
257      if (!debugEmitted && client != null && debugLevel != null) {
258         var thrown = request != null ? request.getException() : null;
259         RestClientDebugPipeline.emit(client.debugLogger, client.debugFormatter, debugLevel, request, this, thrown);
260         debugEmitted = true;
261      }
262      response.close();
263   }
264
265   void setExecTime(Duration value) {
266      execTime = value;
267   }
268
269   /**
270    * Returns response body bytes captured for debug logging (up to the configured body cap).
271    *
272    * @return Captured response bytes, or <jk>null</jk> if not captured.
273    */
274   public byte[] getCachedContent() {
275      return cachedContent;
276   }
277
278   /**
279    * Returns the total response body length observed while reading/draining, or {@code -1} if unknown.
280    *
281    * @return The total body length.
282    */
283   public long getCachedContentLength() {
284      return cachedContentLength;
285   }
286
287   Duration getExecTime() {
288      return execTime;
289   }
290
291   private static final class BoundedCaptureInputStream extends FilterInputStream {
292      private final ByteArrayOutputStream capture = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
293      private final int cap;
294      private long totalBytesRead;
295
296      BoundedCaptureInputStream(InputStream in, int cap) {
297         super(in);
298         this.cap = cap;
299      }
300
301      byte[] getCapturedBytes() {
302         return capture.toByteArray();
303      }
304
305      long getTotalBytesRead() {
306         return totalBytesRead;
307      }
308
309      void drain() throws IOException {
310         while (read() != -1) {
311            // consume
312         }
313      }
314
315      @Override
316      public int read() throws IOException {
317         var b = super.read();
318         if (b == -1)
319            return -1;
320         totalBytesRead++;
321         if (capture.size() < cap)
322            capture.write(b);
323         return b;
324      }
325
326      @Override
327      public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws IOException {
328         var count = super.read(b, off, len);
329         if (count <= 0)
330            return count;
331         totalBytesRead += count;
332         var remaining = cap - capture.size();
333         if (remaining > 0)
334            capture.write(b, off, Math.min(count, remaining));
335         return count;
336      }
337   }
338}
